review.tagline: SDK for adding agent chat, generative UI and shared state to apps
review.summary: CopilotKit is a TypeScript SDK that connects agents to user-facing front ends over the AG-UI protocol. It provides a chat UI, generative UI, shared agent state, human-in-the-loop approvals and a useAgent hook for React, Angular, Vue and React Native, plus a Channels SDK for Slack and Microsoft Teams. Persistent threads, memories and automatic learning are in a separate product, CopilotKit Intelligence.
review.audience: Frontend and full-stack developers adding agents to React, Angular or Vue apps
strengths: Covers React, Angular, Vue and React Native, with Slack and Teams via Channels SDK
Agents can pause for user confirmation or edits (human-in-the-loop)
Shared state is readable and writable by both agent and UI through useAgent
MIT-licensed source; AG-UI protocol is adopted by several agent frameworks
weaknesses: Rich threads, user memories and automatic learning belong to the Intelligence product, not the MIT repo
Vue docs say quickstart is coming soon; Angular is source-only
Discord, WhatsApp and Telegram managed connections are not yet available
Does not run models; needs your own agent backend and LLM provider
needs: Needs Agent backend (AG-UI compatible), LLM provider
